bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for a grant to Twin Cities Recovery Project for posttreatment recovery support.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; TWIN CITIES RECOVERY PROJECT.

$100,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $100,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Twin Cities Recovery Project, a recovery community organization. Grant money must be used to:

(1) provide geographically or culturally specific peer recovery services and education aimed at addressing disparities in posttreatment substance use disorder and mental health support; and

(2) expand access to posttreatment recovery support for high-need populations.
